|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Solo Han (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-102-Solo_Han-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Solo Han (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Solo Han (V)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections III] Han. OR If a battle just initiated, and Han defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced, he adds one destiny to power (+1 for each character and vehicle present), and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. [Immune to Sense]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 36). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Solo Han (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “non-[Reflections III] Han” to “non-[Permanent Weapon] Han (except Falcon)”, “If a battle” to “If battle”, and made the +1 per character and vehicle present a power bonus (“he is power +1 for each character and vehicle present”) instead of a bonus to the added destiny: “Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) non-[Permanent Weapon] Han (except Falcon) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If battle just initiated, and Han defending alone at a site, he is power +1 for each character and vehicle present, his forfeit cannot be reduced, he adds one destiny to power, and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. (Immune to Sense.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_101-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
